details: The European Central Bank (ECB) and other EU central banks are advocating for stricter crypto regulations, particularly concerning stablecoins, foreign-currency tokens, and crypto firms, as part of the MiCA review. They propose removing the current 30-60% bank deposit reserve requirement for stablecoin issuers, suggesting instead that highly liquid assets like Treasury bills be held. This move aims to reduce reliance on commercial banks and enhance market security. Separately, the ECB has launched "Pontes," a new platform enabling banks to settle tokenized assets using central bank money, which could reduce the need for privately issued stablecoins in institutional securities markets.
title: ECB and EU Central Banks Push for Tighter Stablecoin Rules

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget announced on Friday, September 25, 2026, that approximately $387.5 million in assets were stolen in an attack. Initial estimates were lower, but the revised figure includes affected assets on Zcash and TRON. The company suspects a North Korean hacking group may be responsible due to similar IP addresses and attack patterns observed in previous incidents. User funds are reportedly protected by Bitget's User Protection Fund, which holds over $464 million.
title: Bitget Suffers Year's Largest Crypto Hack, $387.5 Million Stolen

details: Stablecoin issuer Circle Internet Group announced on Friday, September 25, 2026, that its Chief Financial Officer, Jeremy Fox-Geen, plans to resign after more than five years. He will remain in the role through the end of 2026 to assist with the transition. Additionally, co-founder Sean Neville has stepped down as a director, effective immediately. Circle is the issuer of USDC, a dollar-pegged stablecoin with a market capitalization of approximately $75 billion.
title: Circle CFO Jeremy Fox-Geen to Step Down Amid Leadership Changes

details: Bitcoin's market dominance has fallen to 58.5%, moving below the 60% threshold, which often suggests a potential shift in investor interest towards altcoins. Data indicates a surge in Glassnode's Altcoin Cycle Signal to 81.25, suggesting favorable conditions for altcoin gains, with the altcoin market cap rising approximately 33% since mid-August. However, the Altcoin Season Index remains neutral, indicating that altcoins have not yet broadly outperformed Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Dominance Drops Below 60%, Signalling Potential Altcoin Interest

details: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig stated that the agency is progressing with the regulation of the crypto market structure, rather than solely waiting for new congressional legislation. The focus includes derivatives markets, perpetual futures, and the development of 24/7 on-chain financial markets.
title: CFTC Moving Ahead with Crypto Market Structure Regulation

details: Cleveland Fed Chair Beth Hammack discussed that rising U.S. Treasury yields are primarily driven by stronger economic growth outlooks, concerns over government debt, and market expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. She noted that robust economic data and tighter monetary policy are influencing investor sentiment, highlighting that liquidity and crypto markets remain sensitive to these macroeconomic shifts.
sourceName: CoinDesk (citing Wall Street Journal's U.S. Stock Market Brief and Reuters)
title: Cleveland Fed Chair Hammack on Rising US Treasury Yields

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) emphasized that stablecoins, digital payments, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), and tokenization are fundamentally reshaping the future of finance, bringing both new opportunities and risks for regulators and policymakers. The IMF's 2026 Annual Report noted robust stablecoin growth and expanding use in cross-border payments. It also cautioned about the potential for stablecoins to become unstable if underlying assets lose value and the risks of "flash crashes" due to rapid tokenized transactions.
title: IMF Highlights Stablecoins and Tokenization Reshaping Finance

details: On September 23, 2026, the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and crypto brokerage Blockchain.com announced their collaboration to explore the creation of tokenized stocks.
title: NYSE and Blockchain.com Explore Tokenized Stocks
